title: ObjectiveDefendActor
description: M9 § ObjectiveKind::DefendActor — forward-compat shape for the M25+ command-core (DR-027) defense game mode. At M9 the actor_id resolves to a Reactor record; M25+ also supports chassis-modules (turrets, bunker walls) as defended actors. The `until_tick` field is the timer's expiry tick (mission resolves Won when the timer expires and the actor is still alive). `loss_on_destroyed=true` means actor destruction immediately resolves Lost (per M9 reactor-defense default).

actor_id.description: Stable id of the defended actor (e.g. reactor id, command_core id, turret id).

until_tick.description: Tick at which the objective resolves Completed if the actor is still alive. Optional; falls back to mission's time_limit_ticks when absent.

loss_on_destroyed.description: True (M9 default): destruction of the defended actor immediately resolves the mission as Lost with loss_reason=ReactorDestroyed (or ActorDestroyed for M25+).

tutorial_safety.description: Per M9 spec § Outcomes — when true, the engine caps the defended actor's HP at 1 with pressure_state=Critical instead of allowing destruction. Player can recover the scenario without restart. M9 default false.
